metadata.documentation: The hand-off between secret-store provisioning and the HoBo claim plane (`hobo claim status|open|finalize`). The transport is in-process; the paths name the operations. The provider side is verified by contracts/provider/secret-store-claim-plane.provider.test.ts, which runs the real provisioning and finalize against a local Infisical stand-in. The bundle carries references only: no claim URL, password or token.

interactions.description: provisioning a self-hosted store returns a claim bundle whose one item carries only a one-time action reference
interactions.providerState: a fresh self-hosted Infisical on a compute fleet host

interactions.description: `hobo claim open secret-store` redeems the owner's sign-in exactly once
interactions.providerState: the store was provisioned and its claim not yet opened

interactions.description: `hobo claim finalize secret-store` verifies through Infisical that HoBo's bootstrap token is refused
